a pathetic excuse: "My dog ate my homework" is a pathetic excuse that no teacher will believe.
「我的狗吃了我的作業」是一個可悲差勁的藉口，沒有老師會相信。
a pathetic attempt: His pathetic attempt at an apology, mumbled without even looking at her, only made her angrier.
他連看都不看她、含糊說出的拙劣道歉嘗試，只讓她更生氣。
a pathetic sight: The thin, wet puppy shivering in the cold rain was a pathetic sight, so we took it home.
那隻瘦弱、濕透、在冷雨中發抖的小狗是個可憐的景象，所以我們把牠帶回家。
be peculiar to: This kind of rice cake is peculiar to the small island and cannot be found anywhere else in Taiwan.
這種米糕是這座小島特有的，在台灣其他地方都找不到。
a peculiar smell: When we opened the door, we noticed a peculiar smell in the kitchen and worried that there was a gas leak.
我們打開門時，注意到廚房有股怪味，擔心是瓦斯外洩。
feel peculiar: After riding the roller coaster three times, I began to feel peculiar, as if I might faint, so I sat down.
坐了三次雲霄飛車後，我開始感覺不舒服，好像快要昏倒，所以就坐了下來。
peculiar circumstances: Under these peculiar circumstances, the school allowed the student to take the exam a week later.
在這些特殊情況下，學校允許那名學生晚一週參加考試。
a peculiar charm: The old town has a peculiar charm, with its narrow streets, red brick houses, and friendly shop owners.
這座老城鎮有種獨特的魅力，有狹窄的街道、紅磚房屋和友善的店主。
a pedestrian crossing: Drivers must stop at a pedestrian crossing when people are walking across the road.
有人正在過馬路時，駕駛人必須在行人穿越道前停車。
a pedestrian area: Cars are not allowed on this street because it has become a pedestrian area for shopping and walking.
這條街不准汽車進入，因為它已經成為逛街和散步的行人徒步區。
a pedestrian performance: The famous actor gave a pedestrian performance in the new movie, and many fans felt bored and disappointed.
這位知名演員在新電影中的表演平淡乏味，許多影迷感到無聊又失望。
pedestrian prose: The story has an exciting plot, but its pedestrian prose makes it hard for readers to stay interested.
這個故事情節精彩，但平淡無奇的文字讓讀者很難保持興趣。
a permanent job: After years of part-time work, my aunt finally found a permanent job with a steady salary.
做了好幾年的兼職工作後，我阿姨終於找到一份薪水穩定的長期固定工作。
permanent damage: Listening to loud music for hours can cause permanent damage to your ears that will never heal.
長時間聽大聲的音樂會對耳朵造成永遠無法復原的永久性損害。
a permanent resident: After living in Australia for many years, Mr. Chen became a permanent resident and bought a house there.
在澳洲住了許多年後，陳先生成為永久居民，並在那裡買了房子。
permanent teeth: Children usually start to lose their baby teeth at six, and their permanent teeth grow in to replace them.
孩子通常在六歲左右開始掉乳牙，恆齒會長出來取代它們。
on a permanent basis: The library hired two of its volunteers on a permanent basis, so they now work there all year round.
圖書館長期性地雇用了兩名志工，所以他們現在全年都在那裡工作。
permanent address: Please write your permanent address on the form, not the address of your school dormitory.
請在表格上填寫你的戶籍地址，而不是學校宿舍的地址。
put things in perspective: Visiting the children's hospital helped me put things in perspective; my small problems seemed unimportant.
參觀兒童醫院幫助我以正確角度看事情；我的小問題似乎變得不重要了。
from a different perspective: If you look at the problem from a different perspective, you may find a better way to solve it.
如果你從不同的角度看這個問題，也許會找到更好的解決方法。
a historical perspective: The museum guide explained the old temple from a historical perspective, telling us how it changed over 300 years.
博物館導覽員從歷史觀點解說這座古廟，告訴我們它三百年來如何改變。
keep a sense of perspective: It is important to keep a sense of perspective; one failed test will not ruin your whole future.
保持客觀判斷很重要；一次考試失敗並不會毀了你的整個未來。
lose perspective: When you are very stressed, it is easy to lose perspective and think every small mistake is a disaster.
當你壓力很大時，很容易失去正確判斷，以為每個小錯誤都是災難。
a persuasive argument: Jenny made such a persuasive argument for a longer lunch break that the principal finally agreed.
珍妮為延長午休提出了很有說服力的論點，校長最後終於同意了。
persuasive evidence: The lawyer presented such persuasive evidence that every member of the jury was convinced the man was innocent.
律師提出了非常令人信服的證據，陪審團的每位成員都相信那名男子是無辜的。
a persuasive essay: For homework, we have to write a persuasive essay to convince readers that school uniforms should be optional.
我們的作業是寫一篇議論文，說服讀者學校制服應該可以自由選擇是否穿。
persuasive writing: Good persuasive writing uses clear reasons and examples to change the reader's opinion.
好的說服性寫作會用清楚的理由和例子來改變讀者的看法。
be pessimistic about: Most fans are pessimistic about the team's chances this season, predicting it will lose almost every game.
大多數球迷對球隊這一季的勝算感到悲觀，預測它幾乎每場比賽都會輸。
a pessimistic view: My uncle takes a pessimistic view of the future and always expects the worst to happen.
我叔叔對未來抱持悲觀的看法，總是預期最壞的事會發生。
a pessimistic forecast: The experts gave a pessimistic forecast, saying the economy would get worse before it got better.
專家們提出悲觀的預測，說經濟在好轉之前會先變得更糟。
